name: Olives (Green)
siboNotes: Green olives are naturally FODMAP-free and well-tolerated in SIBO. Choose varieties without garlic or onion in the brine.
preparationTips: Rinse olives if they're too salty for your taste
Check labels to avoid varieties marinated with garlic or onion
Slice and add to salads or grain bowls for flavor
Store opened jars in refrigerator and use within 2-3 weeks
pairsWellWith: Fresh herbs like basil or oregano
